answer: Splitting into 5 separate vaults demands a separate funded sonnet account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The garden explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the oasis binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 212 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
